messages:
liam_sales: Prospect (Eurosafe Bank) asking for EU-only POC: BYOK, list of all subprocessors, and guarantee that traffic never leaves EU. Also wants a cost delta for tenant pinning + reserved pool vs our default multi-region.
rita_se: Feasible. Two practical paths: (1) Tenant pin + reserved EU capacity (recommended), (2) Keep shared infra but set failover_policy=deny-failover (requests will 503 if EU saturated).
omar_ops: Deny-failover behavior: we return 503 with header `X-RW-Failover: denied`. We'll provide an ops test script to reproduce; also need their IP allowlist for egress filtering and cert fingerprint if they want mTLS.
hana_legal: Preliminary subprocessors: Compute=AWS eu-west-1, Storage=S3 eu-west-1, CDN=Fastly EU, Metrics=Datadog EU, KMS=AWS KMS EU. I will run the formal subproc attestation and flag any control-plane endpoints outside EU. ETA 48h.
maria_fin: Ballpark cost: for 8M tokens/mo, reserved tenant-pin in EU ≈ +25% (range 15-35%) vs multi-region shared. Deny-failover option has no reservation fee but carries availability risk. I'll model both and send spreadsheet.
rita_se: BYOK notes: we accept customer-managed AWS KMS keys in-region. Onboarding requires granting our service principal Encrypt/Decrypt and a test envelope exchange. HSM/on-prem key custody is enterprise-only and needs extra timeline.
omar_ops: Ops checklist draft:
- configure tenant_pin=eu-west-1
- set routing.failover_policy=deny-failover (if requested)
- provision reserved pool if opted
- register BYOK KMS ARN and run handshake
- provide EU egress IPs + certs to customer
- run saturation test during maintenance window
ops-bot: reserved-pool job created RP-1801239999 (eu-west-1)
liam_sales: Customer needs a 1-page note for security: what deny-failover means, subprocessors list, and BYOK steps. Can legal+ops produce and Ill share?
hana_legal: Yes, I will prepare a concise memo with subprocessors, residual risks, and proposed DPA language.
maria_fin: Action items: maria -> cost spreadsheet, omar -> ops checklist + test script, hana -> subproc memo. I'll consolidate and send to Eurosafe.
rita_se: Also prepping a short FAQ on retry/backoff patterns and expected 503 behavior to help their engineers.
liam_sales: Thanks folks. Ping when docs ready and I'll schedule the POC kickoff call. :thumbsup:
